factual_claims.claim: Nordic Fibreboard AS’s financial performance weakened in 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: Consolidated net sales decreased 3.4% to €7.33 million from €7.59 million in 2024. EBITDA turned negative €420 thousand from negative €25 thousand. Net loss widened to €1.15 million from €0.79 million.

factual_claims.claim: Consolidated revenue declined 3.4% to €7.33 million from €7.59 million in 2024, with fibreboard sales accounting for virtually all revenue.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Consolidated net sales for 2025 were € 7.33 million, which is a decrease of 3.4% compared to 2024 sales of € 7.59 million.' Table: Fibreboards production and sales €7,325k (2025) vs €7,567k (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Sales within the European Union, which represented 92% of total revenue, remained relatively stable, while sales to Africa, Asia and the Middle East decreased.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Groups' Revenue by Regions table: EU €6,702k (92%) vs €6,921k (91%) in 2024; Africa €200k vs €305k; Asia €161k vs €212k; Middle East €96k vs €139k.

factual_claims.claim: Real estate management revenue fell to €3 thousand from €25 thousand following the termination of rental agreements in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'Sales revenue from real estate management was € 3 thousand (2024: € 25 thousand).' Real Estate Management section: 'The sales revenue decreased due to the termination of rental agreements in August 2024.'

factual_claims.claim: Profitability deteriorated substantially.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial Statements: EBITDA turned negative €420k (2025) from negative €25k (2024). Net loss widened to €1.15 million from €0.79 million.

factual_claims.claim: EBITDA declined to a negative €420 thousand from negative €25 thousand, reducing the EBITDA margin to negative 6% from 0%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial Ratios table: EBITDA 2025: -€420k (margin -6%); 2024: -€25k (margin 0%).

factual_claims.claim: The fibreboard segment generated negative EBITDA of €296 thousand, compared with positive EBITDA of €26 thousand in 2024, while the real estate segment’s negative EBITDA increased to €86 thousand from €48 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: EBITDA by Business Segments table: Fibreboards production and sales EBITDA 2025: -€296k vs +€26k (2024); Real Estate Management EBITDA 2025: -€86k vs -€48k (2024).

factual_claims.claim: The production business was affected by underutilized capacity, which increased the cost of internally produced goods.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Performance of Business Units section: 'The negative EBITDA was a result of underutilized capacity which makes the own production of goods more expensive.'

factual_claims.claim: In addition, a planned factory shutdown in December to transition to a new gas boiler house resulted in continuing personnel, maintenance and repair costs, with an estimated negative EBITDA impact of approximately €0.2 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The negative EBITDA in both 2025 and 2024 was attributable to the factory shutdown in December... During the shutdown, personnel costs, ongoing factory maintenance costs, and repair costs continued to accrue... had a negative impact on EBITDA.' Performance of Business Units: '...had a roughly € 0.2 million negative impact on EBITDA.'

factual_claims.claim: The boiler-system upgrade was completed in January 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Forecast and Development section: 'The Group has carried out an investment in modern energy solutions... As part of the project, the boiler system used for steam production is being upgraded, which was finally completed in January 2026.'

factual_claims.claim: The Group’s operating loss increased to €940 thousand from €547 thousand, and net loss widened to €1.15 million from €786 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Profit or Loss: Operating loss 2025: -€940k vs -€547k (2024); Net loss 2025: -€1,154k vs -€786k (2024).

factual_claims.claim: The net margin therefore declined to negative 16% from negative 10%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial Ratios table: Net margin 2025: -16% vs -10% (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Distribution costs increased to €982 thousand from €935 thousand, while administrative expenses rose to €502 thousand from €381 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 17: Distribution costs 2025: €982k vs €935k (2024). Note 18: Administrative expenses 2025: €502k vs €381k (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Labour expenses increased to €1.93 million from €1.63 million despite average employment declining from 65 to 60 people.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 19: Labour expenses 2025: €1,931k vs €1,630k (2024). Personnel section: 'As at 31.12.2025 the Group employed 60 people (31.12.2024: 68 employees).' Average employment: 60 (2025) vs 65 (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Net financial costs remained significant at €214 thousand, compared with €238 thousand in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'The consolidated net loss of Nordic Fibreboard AS for 2025 was € 1.15 million (2024: net loss € 0.79 million).' Cash Flow Statement: Net financial cost 2025: €214k vs €238k (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Total assets increased to €9.32 million from €8.25 million, mainly due to higher property, plant and equipment and inventories.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position: Total assets 2025: €9,323k vs 2024: €8,252k. Note 8: Property, plant and equipment carrying amount increased from €4,122k to €4,952k. Note 6: Inventories increased from €624k to €1,034k.

factual_claims.claim: Equity rose to €4.46 million from €3.62 million, supported by a €2 million share issue completed in October, although the annual loss reduced retained earnings.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Changes in Equity: Equity 2025: €4,462k vs 2024: €3,616k. Note 13: 'In the autumn of 2025, the share capital of Nordic Fibreboard AS was conditionally increased by 400,000 euros... The issue price of the shares was 0.50 euros per share... The total value of the offering was 2 million euros.' Retained earnings decreased due to net loss.

factual_claims.claim: Total liabilities increased to €4.86 million from €4.64 million, and payables rose sharply to €1.55 million from €0.79 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position: Total liabilities 2025: €4,861k vs 2024: €4,636k. Note 11: Payables and prepayments 2025: €1,553k vs 2024: €788k.

factual_claims.claim: Borrowings and lease liabilities declined to €3.17 million from €3.72 million, but most borrowings were classified as current because lending-covenant requirements were not fulfilled and lender confirmation had not been obtained.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position: Borrowings and lease liabilities 2025: €3,168k vs 2024: €3,724k. Note 10: 'As of 31.12.2025, all three covenants remained were not fulfilled and since there is no confirmation from the lender regarding the acceptance of non-fulfillment of the covenants, the loan received from Coop Pank AS is recorded in the balance sheet as short-term...'

factual_claims.claim: Cash flow remained under pressure.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash Flow Statement: Net cash generated from operating activities 2025: -€503k vs +€73k (2024). Management Report: 'The Group`s operating result in 2025 was negative cash flow of € 503 thousand (negative cash flow of € 174 thousand in 2024).'

factual_claims.claim: Operating activities used €503 thousand, compared with €174 thousand in 2024, while investing activities used €989 thousand, principally for production assets and real estate development.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash Flow Statement: Cash generated from operations 2025: -€503k vs -€174k (2024). Cash used in investing activities 2025: -€989k. Note 8: 'During 2025, investments in production technology amounted to €1,334k.' Note 7: 'Capitalized cost of investment property... €161k during 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: Financing generated €1.44 million, including the share issue, leaving cash at only €5 thousand at year-end.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash Flow Statement: Net cash from financing activities 2025: +€1,444k. Consolidated Statement of Financial Position: Cash and cash equivalents 2025: €5k vs 2024: €53k.

factual_claims.claim: Working capital was negative €2.7 million, compared with negative €0.7 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 25: 'As of 31.12.2025, the Group's working capital was negative € 2,7 million. This situation was caused by the Group's negative financial results in 2025... negative by € 0.7 million as at 31 December 2024.'

factual_claims.claim: Management plans to address this position through the proposed sale of ten Admirali Quarter properties, supported by a preliminary agreement signed in January 2026.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 26: 'After the balance sheet date, on 08.01.2026 Nordic Fibreboard AS entered into a preliminary sale-purchase agreement for the sale of ten properties... The final sale-purchase agreement... will be concluded... no later than 30.06.2026.' Note 25: 'The Group plans to liquidate negative working capital by selling properties in Suur-Jõe street 48, Pärnu and 10 properties on Admiral Street... sufficient, in the opinion of management, to make necessary investments or pay liabilities that will be realized within 12 months from the date of preparation of the report.'
